name: Stanisław Otto-Trąmpczyński

events.note: Wojciech's nephew and ward; the division of Trąbczyn with their uncle Wojciech was made on the Monday after Jubilate Sunday 1591.

events.type: Party to his mother's settlement of 1596
Among the heirs of Trąbczyn, as son of Jan

notes: Not the Stanisław who was Wojciech's son: the term of 1616 lists "Stanisław son of Jan" and "Stanisław son of Wojciech" separately.
